concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-multi-pay-in-refunds]] — 2026-09-15 third-party multi pay-in refund guide for Adyen balance deductions, authorization-split fallback, asynchronous webhooks and partner-owned customer return; no shopper-receipt proof.
warnings: Adyen's return to the multi pay-in account and the pay-in partner's customer refund are distinct legs.
The raw split-field matrix marks account required while the Commission example omits it; do not infer a universal per-type field rule.
Illustrative webhook payloads have cross-tab identity/amount inconsistencies and do not prove account-specific ledger activity.
